**Result**: All tests now pass (9 passing, 39 todo)

**Approach**: This is minimal — the block rule is expressed as one boolean check plus one hardcoded constant (60), which is exactly what the current test demands. No generalization was attempted for the future tests still on the todo list (4 runes / 7 runes with no block, mixed types, two separate blocks); those will force the grouping logic when they are activated.
